name: Bildad
summary: Bildad the Shuhite was one of Job's three friends, who came to comfort him and then argued that God does not pervert justice. The LORD later said the three friends had not spoken of Him what was right.

key_moments.title: Comes to Comfort Job
key_moments.description: Bildad came with Eliphaz and Zophar to mourn with Job and comfort him. They sat with him on the ground for a whole week, and no one spoke, for his grief was very great.

key_moments.title: Tells Job to Seek God and Be Restored
key_moments.description: Bildad told Job his words were like a strong wind and asked whether God twists justice. He said that if Job sought God and were pure and upright, God would rise up for him and make him prosper again.

key_moments.title: Rebuked by the LORD
key_moments.description: The LORD was angry with the three friends for not speaking right of Him. Bildad went with Eliphaz and Zophar and did as the LORD commanded, and the LORD accepted Job.
